definitionZh: 中风偏倾CSS属性定义了SVG形状中风的不透明度. 效果与......相同,但只适用于中风,而不是整个元素。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of an SVG shape's stroke. The effect is identical to that of , except it is applied only to the stroke, not to the entire element. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
